title: 第17章 周通 给爷跪下第18章 宠爱新师尊莫流苏嫉妒了
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
“好大的口气，你还真敢白日做梦！”
莫流苏和陈灵儿的脸色立刻变得难看。
葛红秋和姜玉瑶则直接暴怒，指着周通的鼻子痛骂。
这两个条件，她们一个都不能接受。
多年以来，她们都是从骨子里看不起周通的，在她们眼里，周通甚至连奴仆都不如。
让她们朝周通跪拜，这比杀了她们都要难受。
“七星碧血莲你就不用妄想了，那是宗门的圣物，仅此一朵，价值无穷，不是你有资格染指的！”
莫流苏冰冷的说道：“至于让她们向你跪拜，我只能说你消受不起，再换一个条件！”
“呵呵…”
周通忍不住冷笑：“你以为我是在跟你商量吗？错了！这是通知，也是命令，你只能选择做与不做，从来就没有更换的选项。”
“你在威胁我？”
莫流苏散发出了无危险的气息。
“那是当然，这么简单都看不出来吗？”
周通毫不退缩的回应道，令人心头轻颤，这少年居然如此刚硬，看来恨一个人真的能天长地久。
“畜生，真以为我们治不了你吗？我就算是跪一条狗也不会向你屈服！”
葛红秋等人忍无可忍，换做从前，周通哪敢这般嚣张，他连个屁都不敢放！
“那你就等着你们心爱的小师弟变成一条死狗吧，我的时间多的很，他却坚持不了多久了。”
周通轻松的说道，此时此刻，唐七正处于水深火热中，浑身的肌肤都裂开了，像是一个血人，几乎奄奄一息。
但周通知道，这家伙并没有那么容易死去，前世他不仅受命运眷顾，体内还隐匿着一道强大的灵魂，拥有诸多底牌。
但今日在众目睽睽之下，他若动用底牌，一来容易暴露，二来消耗极大，不到万不得已的地步，他是绝对不会出招的。

听到这话，莫流苏的脸色变了又变，心中早已经怒火中烧。
“你以为害死了小七，我就会重新收你为徒吗？”
“免了吧，你这种货色就算是跪着求我拜师，我现在也看不上啊！”
周通毫不客气的回怼，不留一丝情面。
“好好好…既然这是你的选择，那我希望你以后不要后悔。”
莫流苏深深的吸了一口气，目光变得无情。
她转身看向身边的三个女弟子道：“我接受你的条件。”
“师尊！”
姜玉瑶和葛红秋脸色大变：“难道你真的要让我们跪拜这个废物吗？”
“怎么？不愿意吗？还是说你们想看着唐七死去？原来你们对他的感情也不过如此！”
周通在一旁笑道，让几人脸色一变，但紧接着，姜玉瑶就露出了嘲讽的神色。
“我知道了，你是在嫉妒小师弟，想看看我们究竟能为他做到哪种程度！”
“那我就告诉你好了，你连小师弟的一根头发都比不过，像你这种垃圾，就算是立刻死去我们也不会在意，而为了救小师弟，我们甚至可以不要尊严！”
她自我感动的说道，然后利索的朝着周通跪了下去，脸上还带着戏谑之色。
看到这一幕，周通只觉得无语，露出了比吃了半斤苍蝇还要恶心的表情。
“哈哈…看来你是被师姐说到痛处了，你真可怜，永远都在跟小师弟比较，却永远比不上！”
说着，她也跪了下去，仿佛这是一件光荣的事情。
陈灵儿也紧随其后，双膝触地的那一刻，她依旧表现的高高在上，像是在赏赐周通。
content_en:
"What a loud tone, you really dare to daydream!"
Mo Liusu and Chen Ling'er's expressions immediately turned ugly.
Ge Hongqiu and Jiang Yuyao were furious and pointed at Zhou Tong's nose and cursed.
Neither of these two conditions could be accepted by them.
For many years, they had looked down on Zhou Tong from the bottom of their hearts. In their eyes, Zhou Tong was even worse than a slave.
Asking them to kneel down and worship Zhou Tong was more uncomfortable than killing them.
"Seven-star Green Blood Lotus, you don't have to have any delusions. It is a sacred object of the sect. This is the only one with infinite value. You are not qualified to get your hands on it!"
Mo Liusu said coldly: "As for asking them to kneel down to you, I can only say that you can't bear it, so let's change the conditions!"
"Haha..."
Zhou Tong couldn't help but sneer: "Do you think I'm discussing with you? Wrong! This is a notice and an order. You can only choose whether to do it or not. There is never an option to change it."
"Are you threatening me?"
Mo Liusu exuded a non-dangerous aura.
"Of course, can't you see it's so simple?"
Zhou Tong responded without flinching, which made people's hearts tremble. This young man is so stubborn. It seems that hating someone can really last forever.
"Beast, do you really think we can't cure you? I won't surrender to you even if I'm a dog!"
Ge Hongqiu and others couldn't bear it anymore. In the past, Zhou Tong wouldn't have dared to be so arrogant. He wouldn't even dare to fart!
"Then you just wait until your beloved junior brother turns into a dead dog. I have a lot of time, but he can't hold on much longer."
Zhou Tong said easily, at this moment, Tang Qi was in dire straits, the skin all over his body was cracked, like a bloody man, almost dying.
But Zhou Tong knew that this guy would not die so easily. In his previous life, he was not only favored by fate, but he also had a powerful soul hidden in his body and had many trump cards.
But today, in full view of the public, if he uses his trump card, it will be easily exposed, and it will cost a lot of money. He will never make a move unless it is absolutely necessary.
Hearing this, Mo Liusu's expression changed again and again, and his heart was already filled with anger.
"Do you think that if you kill Xiao Qi, I will accept you as my disciple again?"
"Forget it. Even if you kneel down and beg me to become my disciple, I won't look down on you now!"
Zhou Tong responded unceremoniously, showing no mercy.
"Okay, okay...since this is your choice, I hope you won't regret it in the future."
Mo Liusu took a deep breath and his eyes became ruthless.
She turned around and looked at the three female disciples beside her and said, "I accept your conditions."
"Master!"
Jiang Yuyao and Ge Hongqiu's expressions changed greatly: "Do you really want us to kneel down and worship this trash?"
"What? Are you unwilling? Or do you want to watch Tang Qi die? It turns out that your feelings for him are nothing more than this!"
Zhou Tong laughed at the side, causing several people's expressions to change, but then Jiang Yuyao showed a mocking look.
"I understand, you are jealous of my junior brother and want to see how far we can go for him!"
"Then I'll tell you, you can't even compare to a hair of my junior brother. We won't care about a piece of trash like you even if you die immediately. And in order to save our junior brother, we don't even have to give up our dignity!"
She said touched by herself, and then knelt down neatly towards Zhou Tong, with a joking look on her face.
Seeing this scene, Zhou Tong felt speechless and showed an expression more disgusting than eating half a catty of flies.
"Haha... It seems that you have been hurt by senior sister. You are so pitiful. You are always comparing yourself to your junior brother, but you can never compare!"
As she said that, she also knelt down, as if this was an honorable thing.
Chen Linger followed closely behind. The moment her knees touched the ground, she still acted condescendingly, as if she was rewarding Zhou Tong.
